title: Tied by hand in *amber*
hero_alt: A teal Yi Xing gift box tied with amber satin ribbon beside an open bracelet box
dek: Six designs to give this season, and how we wrap them.

body.html: Every Yi Xing bracelet leaves our boutiques in a hinged teal box lined in ivory velvet, with our mark in gold foil inside the lid. For gifts, we tie the box by hand with amber satin ribbon and add a card written in the boutique.
Gift wrapping and the card are complimentary. If you are not sure of the wrist size, choose the design and it can be resized later at any of our boutiques.
